items.summary: Compliance baseline is technical only: 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown across the scanned portfolio. Create no site-specific disclosure claim from the aggregate result. After capacity clearance, validate affiliate disclosure presence, placement, and destination consistency per affected site using retained compliance evidence; preserve unknowns where the scan lacks site-level proof. No production release should clear a disclosure gap without the existing review gate.

Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, data handling, and claims boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, do not send rights outreach, and reject the three new scaffold admissions this cycle. Evidence: Woot terms do not establish rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, affiliate, or advertise returned data; 0/4 legal tasks are closed; security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete; compliance is technical-only at 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown; delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle covering the repository/config data-flow and retention table, deployed consent behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, log-field/access inventory, vendor terms/DPA status, and incident/request procedures. Human counsel is required for upstream redistribution rights, commercial/public display, affiliate or advertising use, and jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment.

Data-use dispositions: Woot deal and price-history data = blocked pending written permission and human-counsel review; user alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed pending data inventory, retention/deletion/correction, processor terms, and notification consent/unsubscribe evidence; GA4 = evidence_needed pending deployed consent withdrawal behavior, property/data-sharing and retention settings, and jurisdiction review; operational logs and Cloudflare data = evidence_needed pending log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms/DPA review, and incident/request procedures. No item is clear. Smallest next action for each is a read-only evidence capture; do not enable tracking, expand notifications, collect new data, send outreach, or change the private gate.

Ordinary growth is not blocked merely by incomplete telemetry, but no disclosure, affiliate, copyright/trademark, provenance, platform-policy, claims, or age-sensitive gap may be cleared without site-specific evidence. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA request only as conditional implementation after capacity and overlap clearance; retain its recorded affiliate baseline and require disclosure/link validation, deterministic tests, and rollback evidence. Do not claim revenue, ROI, attribution, or causal lift.
